study type: Prospective cohort study with secondary analysis
cohort: A cohort of 20,780 pregnancies undergoing second-trimester serum screening for Down syndrome.
finding: High levels of AFP and b-hCG but low levels of uE3 in second-trimester serum were significantly associated with higher rates of preterm, early preterm, and very early preterm delivery.
gest_age: Preterm birth defined as < 37 weeks, early preterm as < 34 weeks, and very early preterm as < 32 weeks gestation.
